idea: By Cauchy–Schwarz, the sum of the three reciprocal pair sums is at least the square of the sum of their numerators divided by the corresponding weighted sum. Equivalently, after clearing positive denominators, the claim reduces to a polynomial inequality that `nlinarith` can verify from positivity.
proof:
rcases h₀ with ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩
have hxy : 0 < x + y := by linarith
have hyz : 0 < y + z := by linarith
have hzx : 0 < z + x := by linarith
have hs : 0 < x + y + z := by linarith
have h1 : 0 < (x + y) * (y + z) * (z + x) := mul_pos (mul_pos hxy hyz) hzx
field_simp
rw [div_le_iff₀ hs]
rw [div_le_iff₀ h1]
nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - y), sq_nonneg (y - z), sq_nonneg (z - x)]
